messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: CRITICAL - /v1/generate 5xx spike detected in canary cluster (canary-us-east-1). Trigger: canary-healthcheck-retry-loop. Escalation: release-oncall -> eng-oncall. Pager: fired.

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident <https://pd.example/INC12345|INC12345> created, triggered by metric rule 'canary-5xx-rate > 1% (5m)'. Acknowledgement required.

Jordan: acking the page, jumping in. seeing the canary traffic graph now, big spike starts at ~7532101000s.

Maya: oncall here too. quick checks: canary pods show elevated 502/504s and a lot of retry loops in the forwarder logs.

Jordan: logs (canary-forwarder tail):
```
2026-03-15T21:20:05Z WARN request retry id=aa3 attempt=4 upstream=embedder-2 status=502
2026-03-15T21:20:05Z ERROR upstream call failed: connection reset by peer
```

Ravi: reproducer note: curl to canary ingress returns 502 intermittently, but stable cluster is green. looks like the canary model-worker started returning connection resets after the new image rolled.

Lina: @Jordan @Maya tagging support and CS: we may need to pause rollout and divert traffic, possible customer impact.

Sam (CS): FYI - ticket #7892 from AcmeCorp reporting generation errors since 21:18. They see 502s and timeouts.

Jordan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause canary rollout, 2) shift 100% traffic back to stable, 3) rollback canary image. Doing step 1 now.

Maya: paused the rollout in the release controller. Command used: `kubectl patch rollout canary-release --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/paused","value":true}]'`

Ravi: shifting traffic back to stable via router weight API. patching traffic-split: canary->0%, stable->100%.

pd-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by Jordan. Escalation suspended.

Jordan: running rollback: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/canary-model --to-revision=42`

Maya: rollback triggered, watching pods.

Lina: pinging SRE infra to confirm node-level issues aren't the cause: @Ravi please check kernel OOM / dmesg on canary nodes.

Ravi: checked dmesg, no OOMs. Kernel shows many TCP resets from worker-ip-10-2-7-34. suspect new image introduced a connection handling regression (retry backoff missing).

Sam (CS): informing affected customers: sent templated note to AcmeCorp and BetaStart, mentioning rollback and ETA ~15m.

Maya: rollback finished, new pods are the previous revision, healthchecks passing. I see 200s from canary now when probed.

Jordan: verifying global perf: reconnecting router traces, no 5xx spikes on stable, canary errors subsided after rollback.

Ravi: confirming logs show retry loop rate reduced to baseline.

Lina: marking immediate customer impact: some enterprise customers experienced errors for ~12 minutes, estimated error rate peaked ~3% of gen requests for the rollout cohort.

pd-bot: Updating PD incident INC12345: mitigated by rollback and traffic diversion.

Jordan: next steps: create short incident bridge for postmortem, collect promptsets and telemetry around failing requests, and gate the next rollout with stricter healthchecks and connection-level timeouts.

Maya: I'll put a blocker on the rollout (disable automated promotions) and open an RFC to add a retry/backoff test in canary harness.

Ravi: I'll capture network traces and core dumps (if any) from the bad pods and upload to the incident bucket.

Sam (CS): CS notified customers with a follow-up and asked to reopen tickets if they still see issues.

Lina: handing off to Ravi for the investigation runbook and postmortem. Ravi is now primary owner. Jordan: oncall remain available for any rollbacks.

Ravi: taking ownership. I'll schedule a 30min triage in #incidents-bridge in 10m and post preliminary findings.

Jordan: thanks everyone — please add any logs or traces to the PD incident and the shared drive. Severity: Sev2.

Maya: quick note: add a canary timeout guard in the router so future image regressions don't spin infinite retries.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status updated: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Postmortem required.

pd-bot: PD incident INC12345: Responder notes appended.

Lina: :thumbsup: closing slack thread for live mitigation. follow-up actions assigned in the incident doc.
